scripts.test: tsx --test platform/accounts/test/*.test.ts packages/platform-client/test/*.test.ts && node --test scripts/test/*.test.mjs && npm run test:voice
scripts.check: npm run type-check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.build:staging: npm run build:staging --workspace @canopy/console && node scripts/wrangler.mjs staging build:api && node scripts/wrangler.mjs staging build:console
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run check && npm run build:staging && npm run db:migrate:staging && node scripts/wrangler.mjs staging deploy:api && node scripts/wrangler.mjs staging deploy:console
scripts.deploy:staging:site: npm run build:staging --workspace @canopy/console && node scripts/wrangler.mjs staging deploy:console
scripts.install:voice:staging: npm run check && npm run build:staging && node scripts/install-voice.mjs --config config/voice.staging.json
